cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Prove Your Loyalty
cards.instruction: Invent small tests of loyalty and judge every response without admitting there is a test.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Could you keep Friday free? I might need help moving. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've promised to help Alex paint.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Right. Paint takes priority. Could you at least leave your phone on?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Of course. Have you actually found a flat?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Still looking. Nice that I'm worth a charged battery. This is just planning.
